plugins.name: project-advisory
plugins.description: Advice for a web project: a health check with a branded PDF report, an implementation roadmap, a weekly council that proposes and stress-tests ideas for growth, a venture board for what the business could become, and an invention lab that invents new things for the site, app or tool itself.
